d: Short, choppy dark brown hair with uneven bangs and a slight cowlick. Sharp, narrow emerald green eyes with a focused expression on a youthful, mature face. A slender, fit build wearing a black, form-fitting short dress with blue lace ruffles, blue criss-cross accents on the torso, and blue high-heeled pumps. Accessories include sheer black thigh-high stockings held by black garters and multiple silver daggers strapped to the thighs and floating around the skirt.
